title: Choose the visual world
question: Shopping with Agent’s homepage: pick a world, or re-roll. Waiting in the re-roll pool: Risograph, split-flap concourse, daylight section.

options.label: Agent Sidebar
options.thesis: The homepage is the panel you already talk to: a live agent shopping, plus an honest Add server control.
options.viewport: Full-bleed workspace: activity strip, agent rail with a labeled-synthetic product compare, and Download shopping-mcp.json as the rail’s primary control — never a fake Connected state.
options.risk: Reads as a Cursor clone, and ChatGPT-only shoppers may not see themselves.

raised.raise: The workspace is one registered tool surface — titlebar, rail, transcript — not a chat widget pasted on a landing page.
Agent replies cascade into the rail live, not as a screenshot of one finished answer.
The page is one continuous workspace section; marketing blocks do not stack under it.

options.label: Chat Transcript
options.thesis: The page is the conversation. You watch the assistant shop, then add the server so yours can too.
options.viewport: A full-page thread: a product ask, compared results in-stream (synthetic, labeled), sticky composer is Download shopping-mcp.json plus the three next steps.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Massin Stage
options.thesis: You and the assistant are two voices on a spread; volume is type size, compare is an argument across the gutter.
options.viewport: Shopper ask in one voice, assistant compare in another; Download shopping-mcp.json sits as the next line of dialogue, not a SaaS button row.
options.case: Holds identification: conversation is the shopper’s real scene. Loses clarity: theater can hide that this is an MCP server you add.
options.risk: Reads as a playbill, not a tool you can finish in one sitting.

options.label: Punched Brocade
options.lineage: Jacquard punch cards to woven motif
options.thesis: mcp.json is the punch card. The weave is products your assistant can find.
options.viewport: Instruction rows (the config) on one band, a woven catalog motif on the other; the primary control is punch this card — download shopping-mcp.json.
options.case: Holds product clarity: instructions that become shopping is the mechanism. Loses identification: shoppers do not live at a loom.
options.risk: Beautiful, and it can feel like a textile museum instead of Add this server.

options.label: Lineup Sheet
options.thesis: No pictures. Add this server is the headliner; everything else is billing size.
options.viewport: SHOPPING WITH AGENT and DOWNLOAD MCP CONFIG span the sheet; shopper steps and a quiet store-owner line pack into the justified foot.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the action is readable from across the room. Loses identification: a concert poster is not an assistant.
options.risk: Shouts. Can feel like a gig, not a tool you add once.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Split-audience hero, two cards, product photography, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, then For shoppers / For store owners as equal cards — the arrangement this category always ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI-commerce landing, by design.
